# Windows-Style Unified Menu — 3 Mockups Great direction. Right now the footer has **two competing interactions**: the avatar opens a `UserInfo` panel (bottom-left), while the ellipsis opens a separate `MainMenu`. Users have to know which is which. A unified "Start Menu" fixes the mental model: **one click → everything about *you* on the left, everything you can *do* on the right.** Below are three distinct concepts. All are **mockups only — no files touched yet.** Pick one (or a hybrid) and I'll implement it. --- ## 🏆 Direct Recommendation **Mockup A (Windows 11 Split Panel)** is the strongest fit for codx-junior: it maps directly to the Windows Start Menu metaphor you asked for, keeps the glanceable wallet/limit data visible, and reuses the menu structure you already have in `MainMenu.vue` with zero data-logic changes. --- ## Mockup A — "Start Menu" Split Panel *(recommended)* Anchors above the sidebar footer. Left = your account rail (identity, wallet, limits, session actions). Right = navigation menu. Fixed footprint, no scroll required on desktop. **When it wins:** Desktop-first power users, matches the literal Windows metaphor, max information density. ```vue
{{ userName }}
online
Wallet balance
{{ formatCoins(wallet?.balance_cxjcoins) }} cxj
Today {{ formatCoins(todayCoins) }} / {{ formatCoins(dailyLimit) }}
Navigate
Tools
``` --- ## Mockup B — "Command Center" Overlay A centered, backdrop-dimmed overlay (Spotlight / Win11 full-screen Start). Larger canvas, search-first, with the account rail on the left and menu in a **two-column grid** on the right. Can also be triggered with `Cmd/Ctrl + K`. **When it wins:** Power users who want a keyboard-driven, high-density launcher; feels premium and modern. ```vue
{{ userName }}
online
Pinned
Workspaces
Settings
``` --- ## Mockup C — Compact Drill-Down Flyout Smallest footprint — a ~340px popover that opens at the footer. Top shows the user strip, then a scrollable menu list. **Wallet/limits collapse inline** (accordion) so casual users see a clean menu, while power users expand the money panel when needed. **When it wins:** Minimal visual noise, closest to a traditional OS context menu, least intrusive during chat sessions. ```vue
{{ userName }}
{{ $users.user?.email }}
online
Wallet {{ formatCoins(wallet?.balance_cxjcoins) }}
``` --- ## 📊 Comparison | Criterion | A — Split Start | B — Command Center | C — Compact Flyout | |---|---|---|---| | Windows metaphor | ✅ Strongest | 🟡 Overlay variant | 🟡 Context-menu feel | | Footprint | 580 × 520 | 720 × 560, dimmed bg | 340 × auto | | Info density | High | High (+ search) | Low–Medium | | Keyboard support | Tab / Esc | ⭐ `Cmd/Ctrl+K`, search | Tab / Esc | | Sidebar-collapse friendly | ✅ (floats) | ✅ | ✅ | | Implementation effort | 🟡 Medium | 🔴 High (grid + search) | 🟢 Low | | Best for | Default daily driver | Power users | Minimal / focused work | --- ## ⚠️ Anti-Patterns to Avoid (all mockups) - ❌ **Two separate popups again** — the whole point is one trigger, one panel. Do **not** keep `UserInfo` opening independently. - ❌ **`position: fixed` hard-coded coordinates** — anchor to the footer with `relative` parent + `absolute`, so it survives sidebar collapse. - ❌ **Hard-coded pixel widths on the menu list** — use the fixed outer panel, let inner lists flex/scroll. Long email/project names must `truncate`. - ❌ **Only hover-visible affordances** — every actionable row needs a visible focus ring (keyboard users open this exactly like Windows: `Win → arrows`). --- ## ♿ Accessibility Checklist (mandatory for whichever is chosen) - [ ] Trigger exposes `aria-haspopup="menu"` + `aria-expanded` - [ ] Panel has `role="menu"` (or reuse `reka-ui` `Menubar` which handles this) - [ ] `Escape` closes and returns focus to the footer trigger - [ ] `↑ / ↓` moves between items; `Enter` activates - [ ] Focus trap while open (Menu B especially, it's modal) - [ ] Focus ring visible on the trigger: `focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-primary` - [ ] Status (`online`) conveyed with text **and** color dot — not color alone --- ## ✅ Next Step — Pick One Tell me which concept to build and I'll implement it in `DesktopSidebar.vue` + `UserInfo.vue`, including: 1. Add a `panelMode` / `open` state on the footer trigger. 2. Replace the separate dropdown + ellipsis with **one** unified panel component (`UserCommandMenu.vue`). 3. Reuse your existing `MainMenu` items, `WorkspacesMenu`, `SettingsMenu` inside the new panel. 4. Wire the existing wallet/metrics logic from `UserInfo.vue` (no store changes needed). **My vote: Mockup A.** It literally *is* the Windows Start Menu, and it reuses 90% of what `UserInfo.vue` already computes — lowest risk, highest payoff.
